Author: Siren
Name: I-Ching-GL
Punchline: 入无窮之門，以遊无極之野。吾與日月參光，吾與天地為常。
Description: 我是一个FF14学习插件(国服API15)

Author: Siren
Name: Zhouyi
Punchline: 我是一个日随战场摸鱼自动化技能插件。

Author: Siren
Name: Coyote-FFXiv
Description: 通过条件触发实现郊狼的控制，对接Coyote。顺带支持一些RP小功能。

Author: Siren
Name: FFXIV Network Packet Analysis Tool
Description: 一个用于分析游戏内网络包详细内容的Debug工具，更推荐开发人员使用。

Author: Siren
Name: GposeResizer
Punchline: 在 Gpose 中一键切换超高分辨率与隐藏 UI，实现所见即所得的摄影体验。
Description: 在集体动作(Gpose)模式下，允许通过热键将游戏渲染分辨率切换至自定义的超高分辨率。
Changelog:
0.0.0.6 更新内容：
• 适配最新 API 15 接口
• 右键菜单策略调整：默认改为关闭状态，请手动在插件设置中开启
• 右键菜单逻辑优化：支持二级目录展示，结构更整洁
• 功能新增：右键菜单添加「反向面向 (180°)」选项

Author: Siren
Name: CleanWindow
Punchline: 纯净游戏窗口捕获 — 为 OBS 提供无注入画面
Description: 创建一个独立的系统级预览窗口，将纯净的游戏画面（可选含/不含 UI）输出给 OBS 捕获。支持隐身模式，窗口可从任务栏和 Alt+Tab 中隐藏，同时仍被 OBS 识别。支持多语言。

Author: Siren
Name: AutoTriadC
Description: 提供幻卡图鉴快速检索，提供检索未获取幻卡的获取信息。以及提供自动幻卡对局方案，和推荐卡组注入功能。

Author: Siren
Name: Posegraph
Punchline: 从照片或插画识别姿势，一键摆到 GPose 角色身上 / Photo or illustration to Brio pose
Description: 用本地 AI 后端（SAM 3D Body）识别照片或插画里的人物姿势，重定向到你的种族骨架后通过 Brio 应用到 GPose 角色。支持全部可玩种族（男女）、面部表情（测试）、图库、Brio 改动收进图库、多角色各绑一张图（拆分模式）、辅助视角补深度、复刻照片镜头、一键打光与照片同款灯光（可多人）、构图与截图、视频动作（逐帧识别视频，在游戏里播放、时间轴修正、录制，测试）、调整滑杆、导出 .pose，中英文界面。需要 Brio 与 Posegraph 后端（用项目主页的一键安装脚本安装，自动按显卡选 NVIDIA / AMD / CPU 版）。
Changelog:
0.7.7：复刻镜头点开有「普通 / 顺旋 / 逆旋」，拍竖图时游戏照常横屏、镜头侧倒 90°，竖照片占满画面，截图自动转回正的；照片焦距可以改（猜成广角时选 24～135mm 重新识别，带 EXIF 自动用）；复刻镜头更准，不用多点几次，并跟着整体旋转一起转；构图框照片比例可强制横 / 竖；去掉了视频的录制（和 ReShade 冲突）。设置页点「更新后端」换一下代码（约 5MB）。
0.7.7: Match camera offers "Normal / Roll right / Roll left" - for portrait shots the game stays in landscape and the camera rolls 90°, so a portrait photo fills the screen and screenshots are turned back upright; the photo's focal length can be changed (pick 24-135mm and recognize again when it was guessed too wide; EXIF is used automatically); camera matching is more accurate, no more clicking several times, and follows the whole-body rotation; the framing guide can force landscape / portrait with the photo ratio; removed video recording (it conflicts with ReShade). Click "Update backend" in Settings to swap the code (about 5 MB).
0.7.5：姿势转 idle——图库右键「转换为 idle…」，把图片姿势做成站着、坐椅子、坐地上、打盹时的待机动作（选 /cpose 槽位和种族），保留原版呼吸、各部位强度可调，带动作预览、位置和旋转调整，存成 Penumbra 模组。需要 Penumbra。设置页点「更新后端」换一下代码（约 5MB）。
0.7.5: pose to idle - right-click a library image and choose "Convert to idle…" to turn its pose into a standing, chair, ground-sit or doze idle (pick the /cpose slot and races), keeping the original breathing with per-part strength, a motion preview and position / rotation adjustments, saved as a Penumbra mod. Requires Penumbra. Click "Update backend" in Settings to swap the code (about 5 MB).
0.7.4：后端改用一键安装 / 更新脚本（项目主页下载 Posegraph-Installer.zip），自动按显卡选 NVIDIA CUDA 12.8 / 12.6、AMD ROCm 或 CPU，能更新 / 修复已有的后端；修复 AMD 显卡识别报错；识别出错时显示真正的原因，设置页后端日志可一键复制。设置页点「更新后端」换一下代码（约 5MB）。
0.7.4: the backend is now installed with the installer / updater (Posegraph-Installer.zip on the project page), which picks NVIDIA CUDA 12.8 / 12.6, AMD ROCm or CPU for your GPU and can update / repair an existing backend; fixed recognition errors on AMD GPUs; failed recognitions show the actual cause, and the backend log in Settings can be copied. Click "Update backend" in Settings to swap the code (about 5 MB).
0.7.3：自己加灯（主光、轮廓光、头发光等 12 种预设，多人时加到选中的那一套）、恢复默认（整体滑杆、单盏灯、整套）、撤销 / 重做（灯光、3D 布光、调整页、3D 页、视频时间轴，Ctrl+Z / Ctrl+Y）；支持 AMD 显卡（ROCm，按源码安装），AMD / Intel 显卡也能显示可用显存。设置页点「更新后端」换一下代码（约 5MB）。
0.7.3: add your own lights (12 presets such as key, rim and hair light; with several people they go to the chosen set), reset to default (overall sliders, single lights, whole setup), undo / redo (lighting, 3D lighting, Tuning and 3D tabs, video timeline; Ctrl+Z / Ctrl+Y); AMD GPU support (ROCm, source install), and AMD / Intel GPUs show free VRAM. Click "Update backend" in Settings to swap the code (about 5 MB).
0.7.2：多人打光——「照谁」可选一组（一套灯罩住所有人）、每人一套、自动分组，人散开的大场景也都照得到，还能单独调某一套；图库可按改动时间 / 添加时间排序。
0.7.2: lighting several people - "Light who" can light them as a group, one set each, or grouped automatically, so spread-out characters in large scenes are lit too, and any set can be adjusted on its own; the library can be sorted by modified or added time.
0.7.1：补上视频找人要的人物检测组件——老一键包在设置页点「更新后端」会自动补上（约 158MB）。
0.7.1: adds the person detection component that finding people in videos needs - click "Update backend" in Settings to add it (about 158 MB).
0.7.0：视频动作（测试）——逐帧识别视频里的动作、表情和镜头运动，在 GPose 里播放（跟拍 / 走动、多种机位、镜头整体调整），多人同场，时间轴修正（Brio 里改骨骼收成关键帧，复制粘贴到别的帧或区间），同步放音乐、录成视频，换种族自动重算。在设置页点「更新后端」，会自动补上音频组件（约 70MB）。
0.7.0: video motion (beta) - recognizes the motion, expressions and camera movement of a video frame by frame and plays it in GPose (follow / walk, several shot types, overall camera adjustments), several people at once, timeline corrections (keep bones changed in Brio as keyframes, copy and paste them to other frames or ranges), music in sync, recording to video, automatic rebuild for another race. Update the backend in Settings; it adds the audio component (about 70 MB).
